'''Ben Fox Dark Dagobah Clouds''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Ben Fox]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds76.htm Dark Dagobah Clouds], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040719055710/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds76.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
